errors.text_span: 两条线在所有类别中均未相交，且“随机网络”的数值始终高于“中介语网络”
errors.evidence: The reference does not explicitly state that the lines never intersect or that one is always higher, though this is visually true. This is an interpretation beyond the reference's explicit content.
The red line does not show a steady or '逐步' (step-by-step) increase; it fluctuates (e.g., drops at B1). The description oversimplifies the trend.
The blue line does not show a continuous increase; it drops at B1. The description oversimplifies the trend.
